property_summary: After any successful setOwner call by the current admin, a subsequent call to setOwner by that same admin with any new address must succeed and the owner must reflect the new address; the bug viølates this because owner is reset to zero after assignment, so the second call's require(msg.sender == owner) in onlyOwner modifier (if used) would fail, and even without it, owner getter returns zero instead of the new address.
change_summary: Change the owner assignment to `owner = _owner; owner = address(0);` so owner is always reset to zero after assignment.
